summary: Enhanced PLAN_SYSTEM_PROMPT in src/goal/planner.ts with four additions: (1) DOWNSTREAM AGENT CAPABILITIES section after opening paragraph listing tools (Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep/Bash), timeout formula (min(2h, 2x durationMinutes)), unlimited tool chaining, and guidance to describe WHAT not HOW. (2) Backend fallback rule added to BACKEND SELECTION RULES: 'If only one backend is available at runtime, the executor will automatically use the available backend regardless of what you specify.' (3) Risk field added to step schema: risk 'low'|'medium'|'high' with guidance on flagging high-risk steps. (4) Two labeled few-shot examples: GOOD PLAN showing /create_repo Telegram command with 4 specific steps (file paths, numbered sub-tasks, constraints, verifiable criteria), and BAD PLAN showing a grab-bag nightwatch plan with commentary on why it fails (mixed concerns, vague criteria, wall-of-text descriptions, no file paths). pnpm build and pnpm lint both pass with 0 errors.
